manual.esoteric_components.line2: In your travels of this world, you have heard rumors - even found proof - of certain materials beyond common understanding, and with properties outside the realms of common technology.{0}
manual.esoteric_components.line3: Integrating these materials into engineering opens entirely new horizons!{0}
manual.esoteric_components.line5: The §2echo shard§r is such a component, vibrating on frequencies that penetrate the fabric of reality. You dub this phenomenon: §nResonanz§r.
manual.esoteric_components.line6: Encased in a protective lead shell along advanced circuitry, they shall be used in confounding constructions!
